title: Mass Dependence of Araki Relative Entropy through Modular Theory
summary: Building on the established one-particle formula for the Araki relative entropy of coherent states, we study how its value acquires a nontrivial dependence on the mass of the scalar field. For a localized vector $h$ belonging to the standard subspace $H_m$ of the one-particle Hilbert space, the known quadratic-form expression is: $S_{H_m}(h)=-\langle h,\logδ_{H_m}\,h\rangle$. Our contribution is to construct explicitly a mass-indexed family of vectors of the wedge standard subspace on which this expression is evaluated.
